name: awesomeTMC
description: Triplet Markov chains for fast optimal filtering in Gaussian Markov switching systems. Exact filters of the CGOMSM1 and CGOMSM2 families (including a known exogenous input), reference filters (exact mixture filter, IMM, GPB2, Rao-Blackwellized particle filter), supervised and semi-supervised parameter estimation, and the scripts that reproduce the experiments of the companion papers.
keywords: conditionally Gaussian observed Markov switching models
